articles.title: Two youths facing a dozen combined firearm and theft-related charges in alleged e-bike theft
articles.summary: Two teens are facing a dozen combined charges following the alleged theft of an e-bike in North York. articles.title: Woman injured after being struck by vehicle in Etobicoke
articles.summary: A woman was injured after being hit by a vehicle in Etobicoke on Thursday afternoon. Police were called to the area of Bloor Street and Kipling Avenue around 1:15 p.m. for reports of a collision. Emergency crews found an adult female pedestrian who had been struck by a vehicle. She was taken to the hospital […]

articles.title: Racing believed to be factor in deaths of 2 men in North York crash: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say they believe two men who died after their car struck a traffic light pole and knocked it down in North York were racing at the time.

articles.title: Durham police arrest 4, lay 229 charges after string of robberies, thefts, break-ins
articles.summary: Police say they have laid 229 charges against four people, including two youths, in connection with 36 smash-and-grab robberies, vehicle thefts and commercial break-in incidents in the Durham Region and Toronto.

articles.title: Brad Bradford says he will put a Toronto police outpost in Union Station if he’s elected mayor
articles.summary: Brad Bradford has promised a Toronto police outpost at Union Station as part of his mayoral campaign platform.

articles.title: Fatal stabbing in Toronto’s east end not criminal in nature
articles.summary: Toronto police are not looking for suspects after a man was stabbed in the city’s east end Thursday afternoon. Police confirm that the man died and that there was no criminal element to the incident. articles.title: Family members of Toronto filmmaker describe their pain at hearing for couple found guilty in his death
articles.summary: Family members of a filmmaker found dead in a condo trash compactor in Liberty Village described their grief and anguish at a sentencing hearing Wednesday for the couple found guilty in his death.
